verdict.rationale: Polar documents a public HTTP API with versioned OpenAPI 3.1 specs served from its docs site, official typed SDKs, and API coverage for checkout sessions, event ingestion, customer state, proration and webhook endpoint management. The probe's 404s at generic root paths (e.g. /openapi.json) do not contradict the docs-hosted specs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API, and a probe confirming the docs-hosted OpenAPI spec paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: serves versioned OpenAPI specs straight from the docs site (2026-04.openapi.json and 2026-10.openapi.json, OpenAPI 3.1.0 — "Polar HTTP and Webhooks API")
Call the Polar API with full type safety using one of our official SDKs.
If you want to integrate more deeply the checkout process with your website or application, you can use our dedicated API.
Events are sent to Polar using the Events Ingestion API and are stored in our database.
You pick the proration behavior either at the organization level (as the default) or per API call.
